<!-- 2016-05-31T15:08Z https://github.com/octolab/cleaner/issues/24#issuecomment-222718516
- `doc`
  Documentations, manual, readme... (licenses are excluded since they should always stay with the packages)
- `example`
  Examples, tutorials, ...
- `test`
  Test-related files
- `bin`
  Command-line related files (for instance, if a project uses Doctrine DBAL only as a library, the [`bin`](https://github.com/doctrine/dbal/tree/v2.4.5/bin) folder is not needed)
-->
